blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Nighttime lights from NASA’s Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.
blocks.zh: 美国航天局的"黑色大理石"产品套装的夜间灯光捕捉出来自火灾、火山爆发和气体燃烧等异常事件的热和光排放信号。 现有的探测方法主要依靠热波段,将敏感度限制在较弱的信号上. 我们提出了一个新型的机器学习框架,它联合模拟了黑色大理石M波段和日/夜波段(DNB)信号,以得出一个通用的,斯皮提奥-时态强大的异常探测器集合. 该框架迭代地建立探测器,以跨越区域、季节、异常类别并扩展到陆地和海洋。 根据相关波段和探测器协议得出了不同信任水平的探测装置。 这种方法提高了真实的探测率,同时减少了虚假的探测,结果显示,在自然灾害监测和取能方面的应用具有很强的可通用性。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Remotely sensed nighttime lights (NTL) from NASA’s Black Marble product [ 1 ] capture a range of phenomena relevant for understanding and tracking the Earth system at night. These range from natural phenomena such as fires [ 2 ] , aurora [ 3 ] to anthropogenic events such as gas flaring [ 4 ] , urbanization [ 5 ] , [ 6 ] , [ 7 ] , disasters impacting power grids [ 8 ] , [ 9 ] , [ 10 ] , [ 6 ] , electrification [ 11 ] , socio-political conflicts and displacement [ 12 ] , [ 13 ] , [ 14 ] , [ 6 ] , and impacts of unprecedented events such as COVID-19 [ 15 ] , [ 16 ] serving a diverse range of applications [ 17 ] . Black Marble NTL data, derived from the Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) [ 18 ] , offer a unique vantage point for observing daily signals related to these events globally due to the high revisit rate of the SNPP and NOAA-20 satellites. The daily revisit is especially salient for capturing both persistent and transient events while the long-term record from VIIRS allows cataloging these occurrences over time. In particular, the daily top-of-atmosphere Black Marble data at a moderate spatial resolution of 500 m record both natural and anthropogenic anomalous events such as fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring from energy extraction on land and water. VIIRS data have been used for detecting these events based on VIIRS thermal (Moderate M) bands capturing the thermal emission signal. The VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) that lies between the visible and Near-Infrared regions has a large dynamic range and captures the light emission signal of the events and are sensitive to weaker instances with less distinct thermal signals [ 1 ] , [ 4 ] . Although the DNB has improved flare and fire detection [ 2 ] , [ 19 ] , [ 20 ] , it is used as a confirmatory feature only. However, the combined use of thermal (M-bands) and light (DNB) emission signals was shown to improve the detection of these events compared to existing methods (VIIRS 375 m Active Fires and VIIRS NightFire) that use a “thermal band only” approach [ 4 ] . This study developed a machine learning anomaly detector to model the non-anomalous background pixels, creating a threefold advantage: first, it used unsupervised learning to model for background variation that extracted anomalous pixels and accounted for lack of high-quality labels; second it jointly used all Black Marble bands (six M-bands and DNB) to improve detection (higher detection confidence, weaker signal detection, lower false detections); and third it created an independent detection approach, allowing uncertainty estimations when assessed with existing rule-based thermal band approaches. However, the background modeling was localized and region-specific (Eagle Ford Shale, United States) that limits scalability across geographies and seasons.
blocks.zh: 从美国航天局的"黑色大理石"产品中遥感出夜间灯光(NTL)[1]捕捉出一系列与夜间了解和跟踪地球系统相关的现象. 从火灾[2],极光[3]等自然现象到天然气燃烧[4],城市化[5],[6],[7]等人类活动,影响电网的灾害[8],[9],[10],[6],电气化[11],社会-政治冲突和流离失所[12],[13],[14],[6],以及COVID-19[15],[16]等史无前例事件的影响,为各种各样的应用服务[17]. Black Marble NTL数据取自可见红外成像辐射计套件(VIIRS) [18],由于SNPP和NOAA-20卫星的重访率高,为观测与这些事件有关的每日信号提供了一个独特的有利点. 每天的重访对于记录持续和短暂的事件来说尤为突出,而来自第七届特别会议的长期记录则允许对这些事件进行长期分类。 特别是,以500米的中度空间分辨率测得的每日顶层黑大理石数据记录了自然和人为异常事件,如火灾、火山爆发和从陆地和水上取出能源产生的气体燃烧等。 已利用VIIRS数据来探测这些事件,其依据是VIIRS热(Modelate M)波段捕获出热排放信号。 位于可见和近红外区域之间的VIIRS Day/Night Band(DNB)具有很大的动态范围并能捕捉到事件的光放出信号,对热信号较不显著的较弱实例敏感. [1], [4]. 虽然DNB改进了照明弹和起火探测[2],[19],[20],但仅用作确认特征. 然而,与采用“仅限热带”方法的现有方法(VIIRS 375米活性火灾和VIIRS夜火)相比,热能(M-波段)和光能(DNB)排放信号的结合使用表明改进了对这些事件的探测。 本研究开发出一种机器学习异常探测器来模拟非异质背景像素,创造了三重优势:一是利用无监督的学习来模拟背景变异,取出异常像素并解释缺乏高品质的标签;二是联合使用所有的"黑色大理石"波段(6个M-波段和DNB)来改进探测(更高的探测信心,更弱的信号探测,更低的假探测);三是创造了一种独立的探测方法,在用现有的有章可循的热波段方法来评估时允许不确定性估计. 然而,背景建模是局部的和针对地区(美国Eagle Ford Shale)的,限制了跨地理学和季节的可伸缩性.

blocks.en: In this study, we propose a novel suite of spatio-temporally robust, generalized detectors of thermal and light emission anomalies from Black Marble NTL that combines the M-band and DNB signals and derives an ensemble classification of pixels. Our approach builds on the localized method and iteratively constructs the detection workflow leveraging unsupervised detections across regions and seasons. Our modeling builds an effective representation of the large spatio-spectro-temporal variability of the background to detect events. The detectors are generalized, implying geographic and seasonal scalability as well as class-agnostic detections of thermal and light emission anomalies, spanning fires, volcanoes, and gas flares. The approach scales both across the land and ocean. We apply the detectors across known energy extraction sites, retrospectively on fires and volcanic eruptions for demonstration and derive a suite of detections. Accurate ground truth data of these events are limited and thus we use agreement across multiple detectors from our suite to derive a ’high-confidence’ data layer. We observe high overlap between each detector and the merged layer. We also analyze the detections to rank the detectors most relevant for operational use. The DNB layer’s higher sensitivity allows weaker signal detection missed by M-bands and we note these as a moderate-confidence ’DNB-only’ set.

blocks.en: Overall, the contributions of this study are as follows: • a spatio-temporally robust, generalizable thermal and light emission anomaly detection suite using an iterative framework of machine learning ensembles. The approach is globally scalable, extends to land and ocean observations and applicable across classes, including fires, volcanoes, gas flares. • detection sets at varying levels of confidence based on input bands used and agreement between models to form an ensemble. • improves detection performance and weak signal detection by jointly modeling M-bands and DNB while reducing spurious detections. • uses the highest quality NTL, the Black Marble product, making it the first approach to derive Black Marble top-of-atmosphere nighttime anomalies with applications in natural hazard, disaster monitoring, and energy extraction.

blocks.en: II Methodology
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: II-A Iterative multi-step approach
blocks.zh: 二-A 过渡性多步骤办法

blocks.en:
As these events of interest result in a high thermal and light emission signal compared to the background but there is scarcity of high-quality labels, out proposed method takes a multi-step approach. First we use an anomaly detection approach that models the non-anomalous background spectra from a small volume of unlabeled data and monitor deviations from the expected DNB radiance and M-band brightness temperature for detections. This addresses label data scarcity and avoids training on existing thermal band thresholding-based datasets that will bias the detectors to these thresholds and restrict it to a subset of bands only.
The detected anomalies localize possible anomalies and serve as labels required to train a generalized detector that is robust to spatial and temporal variations.
By repeating the anomaly detection step over known event sites, we create a repository of extracted anomalies which then allows refining the detectors iteratively.
We explore different classifiers that learn to distinguish between the two classes (background and anomaly) and use filtering and masking strategies to remove possible contamination to derive a high confidence label set detected by multiple models. These classifiers initially learn regional models trained locally where the anomaly detectors were applied. We then extended to unseen regions by training jointly on detections from different regions and seasons for generalization. Both our anomaly detectors and iteratively-trained classifiers generate two classes of detections, i) with both thermal and light emission signals and are of high confidence, ii) urban-masked DNB emission-only set that is of moderate confidence.
blocks.zh:
由于这些令人感兴趣的事件导致与背景相比的高热能和光能排放信号,但高质量标签很少,因此提议的方法采取多步骤的办法。 首先,我们使用一种异常检测方法,从少量无标签的数据中模拟非异常背景光谱,并监测对预期的DNB光度和M-波段亮度温度的偏差。 这解决了标签数据稀缺的问题,并避免了对基于热带阈值的现有数据集进行培训,这些数据集将使探测器偏向于这些阈值,而将其限制在仅是一组带子.
所发现的异常使可能存在的异常地方化,并成为培训一种对空间和时间变化很强的通用探测器所需的标签。
通过重复在已知事件地点上的异常探测步骤,我们建立了一个提取出异常的存储库,从而可以迭代地改进探测器。
我们探索不同的分类器,学习区分两类(背景和异常),并使用过滤和遮掩策略来去除可能的污染来得到由多模型检测出的高信任度标签. 这些分类人员首先在当地培训区域模型,在那里应用了异常探测器。 然后,我们通过对不同区域和季节的探测进行联合培训,将范围扩大到看不见的区域。 我们的异常探测器和反复训练的分类器都会产生两类探测器,一)具有热能和光能发射信号,并且具有很高的置信度; 二)仅具有中度置信度的城市式DNB排放装置。

blocks.en: The proposed methodology has the following steps as shown in Figure 1 : 1. Anomaly detection (step 1): This step creates local background models of the expected thermal and light emission signal in a given region and monitors deviations in subsequent observations to extract pixel-level multi-spectral signals. 2. Generalized anomaly detector (step 2): (a) The detections from step 1 are then utilized as labels to automate annotating the background and anomalous classes. Anomalous signals can be categorized depending on the subset of bands that respond and are related to event class. At this stage we retain labels for binary classification. (b) Model-annotations are used to iteratively create a generalized detector. We first use the step 1 detections (set-1) as labels to create regional detectors that are applied to a small unseen set of observations from the region (set-2). The models are then refined or retrained on detections of both sets 1 and 2 to create the final generalized regional detector. These are applied to incoming data (test set) over the peak occurrence seasons to examine the performance of the classifiers trained on machine learning generated labels. For both sets 1 and 2 we apply filtering functions to remove contamination to the best of our knowledge. The set 1 and 2 detections of the final regional detectors are jointly trained (across VNP46 tiles) to create a generic model that are then applied to unseen regions and seasons for examining spatio-temporal generalization. While we analyze models from all steps in the workflow, the jointly trained general model (referred as ’joint’), is most important to assess for its suitability to be used operationally.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法有如下步骤,如图1所示: 1. 异常检测(步骤1): 这一步骤为特定区域的预期热和光排放信号创建了局部背景模型,并监测后续观测中的偏差以提取像素级多光谱信号. 2. 一般异常探测器(第2步): (a) 然后用第1步的探测器作为标签,自动说明背景和异常等级。 异常信号可以根据响应并和事件类相关的波段的子集进行分类. 在这个阶段,我们保留二进制分类的标签。 (b) 模型说明被用来迭代地创建通用探测器。 我们首先使用步骤1探测器(set-1)作为标签,以创建区域探测器,用于从该区域(set-2)获得的一小组看不见的观测数据。 然后对这些模型进行精炼或再培训,以探测第1套和第2套,从而产生最后的通用区域探测器。 这些数据应用于高峰期数据(测试集),以检查接受机器学习培训的分类人员在生成标签方面的表现。 对于第1组和第2组,我们运用过滤功能来消除我们所知的污染。 最终区域探测器的一组1和2探测器经过联合培训(跨越VNP46瓦),以建立一个通用模型,然后应用于看不见的区域和季节,以检查斯皮提奥-时空通论。 虽然我们从工作流程的所有步骤分析模型,但共同训练的一般模型(称为`联合 ' )对于评估其是否适合实际使用至关重要。

blocks.en: II-B Input Features
blocks.zh: II-B 输入特性

blocks.en: Thermal Infrared Emission M-10 to M16: We use all VNP46A1 thermal bands to model the non-anomalous background. Anomalous thermal emission spectra are detected based on high error from background model in unseen observations.
blocks.zh: 热红外排放M-10至M16: 我们用所有的VNP46A1热波段来模拟非异常背景. 发现异常的热排放光谱是基于在不见的观测中从背景模型中发现的高误差。

blocks.en: M-10 and M11: As gas flaring peaks in the M-10 and M-11 bands and we observe the peak signal in M-11, we apply the outlier based detection 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T}_{10} , using outliers from the 90 90 -th percentile of the M-11. As these bands do not capture background properties such as land water, clouds, urban areas, these are ideally suited for extracting anomaly without requiring masking.
blocks.zh: M-10和M-11号: 作为M-10和M-11波段的气体燃烧峰,我们观测到M-11的峰值信号,我们应用了基于外线的检测T 10\ mathcal{T-X=10},利用了M-11的90-第9百分位的外线. 由于这些带不捕捉出地水,云,城等背景属性,因此这些特征最适合提取异常而不需要蒙面.

blocks.en: The detections from M-10 to M-16 and the outlier detections of M-11 together form the anomalous thermal emission set.
blocks.zh: M-10至M-16的探测和M-11的外围探测共同构成异常出热装置。

blocks.en:
Light Emission Day/Night Band Models (Visible to Near-Infrared Emission):
The DNB captures light emission information. When DNB detections are in agreement with thermal bands, it forms the joint high-confidence set. When no co-occurrent thermal bands signals are observed, we define this as the moderate confidence set, which is filtered using the ancillary bands described below to retain likely anomalies.
blocks.zh:
轻度排放日/夜带模型(近红外排放可见):
DNB获取了轻度排放信息. 当DNB探测器与热波段一致时,它会形成联合高自信心集. 当没有观测到同源热波段信号时,我们将此定义为中度置信集,使用下面描述的辅助带来过滤来保留可能的异常.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Proposed step 1 consisting of unsupervised background modeling for anomaly detection to extract labels.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 拟议的步骤一包括无监督的背景模型,用于异常检测以提取标签.

blocks.en: II-C Machine Leaning models
blocks.zh: II-C 机器倾斜模型

blocks.en: At each step in the workflow, we explore relevant architectures to determine suitability.
blocks.zh: 在工作流程的每一个步骤,我们都会探索相关的架构以确定是否合适.

blocks.en: Anomaly detectors (step 1) : We use autoencoders (AE) [ 21 ] , [ 22 ] and variational autoencoders (VAE) [ 23 ] to model the background class. We select random pixels from clear-sky nights of regions of interest and train the models to minimize the pixel-level multi-spectral reconstruction error for AE while we used an added KL-divergence term to model the latent space as a standard distribution 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , ℐ ) \penalty\ \mathcal{N}(0,\mathcal{I}) . This builds on the approach proposed in [ 4 ] and also adds the VAE. We apply to unseen scenes from the same region and detect anomalies based on total reconstruction error.
blocks.zh: 异常探测器(第1步): 我们使用自定义编码器(AE)[21],[22]和可变自定义编码器(VAE)[23]来模拟背景类. 我们从感兴趣的区域的晴天之夜中选择随机像素,并训练模型来将AE的像素级多光谱重建出错最小化,同时我们使用一个新增的KL-divergence术语来将潜入空间建模为标准分布 N QQ (0, I)\penalty\\ mathcal{N}(0,\mathcal{I}). 这以[4]中提议的办法为基础,并添加了《公平竞争法》。 我们适用于同一地区的隐形场景,并检测基于全部重建错误的异常现象。

blocks.en: These test samples are selected from clear sky-nights but often have slight contamination from clouds in a small fraction of pixels. We observe that magnitude of total reconstruction error is positive and negative for anomalies and clouds, respectively, allowing filtering out contamination. Clouds have lower brightness temperature compared to background, while anomalies deviate positively. To eliminate clouds, we check for the type of per-band deviation where high negative deviations from the background are removed (as possible cloud cover), while high positive deviations are retained as candidate anomalies. This approach was selected over cloud masking as the VIIRS cloud mask (VNP35) is prone to errors at night, which currently mislabels ’nighttime thermal anomalies’ as ’clouds’. We also mask detections over water due to its higher nighttime brightness temperature. The remaining anomalies are labeled as ‘1’ and background is labeled as ’0’. We repeat this across sites and is shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 这些测试样本是从晴朗的"天夜"中挑选出来的,但往往在一小部分像素中略微被云污染. 我们注意到,总重建出错的程度对异常和云分别是正的和负的,可以过滤出污染。 相较于背景,云的亮度温度较低,而异常偏差正. 为了去除云层,我们检查从背景中去除高负偏差的每段偏差类型(如可能云层覆盖),同时保留高正偏差作为候选异常. 之所以选择这种方法,是因为VIIRS云罩(VNP35)在夜间容易出错,而目前错误地将夜间热异常贴上 " 云 " 的标签。 我们还掩盖了在水面上的探测,因为它的夜间亮度温度较高。 其余的异常被标为 " 1 " ,背景被标为 " 0 " 。 我们在不同地点重复,如图2所示。

blocks.en: The light emission anomaly from DNB is extracted by partitioning the tile radiance into clusters using a Gaussian mixture model and detecting probable light emission based on a pixel’s cluster assignment and its deviation above the highest mean radiance from the background clusters. We also use an alternative approach where an elastic net models each cluster that defines a central pixel using its neighbors to compute the high radiance likelihood.
blocks.zh: 利用高斯混合模型将瓷砖光度分解成集群,并根据像素的集群分配及其从背景集群中最高平均光度的偏差,检测可能的光出,从而提取出DNB的光出异常。 我们还使用另一种方法,即每个集群的弹性网模型,定义一个中央像素,利用邻接来计算高光度概率.

blocks.en:
Generalized spatio-temporal detectors (step 2) :
As anomaly and background spectra show a large dissimilarity, for our generalized detector (step 2) we explored contrastive learning that learns a representation such that similar pairs are grouped together, while dissimilar pairs are projected far apart. Thus, by training on anomaly and background samples, these methods learn embeddings such that (anomaly, anomaly) and (background, background) pairs are grouped together, while (anomaly, background) pair lies far apart. Our iterative model refining is performed using Siamese networks that contain identical subnetworks that share weights, allowing the comparison of features extracted from both the classes using contrastive and triplet losses ( c c , t t ). The network weights are optimized to extract features from each class and derive embeddings that separate them according to their relative similarity. The set 1 and 2 detections from contrastive learning are also used as labeled data for training a fully connected neural network (FCNN) for comparison.
blocks.zh:
一般斯皮提奥-时空探测器(步骤2):
由于异常和背景光谱显示出了巨大的异同性,对于我们的通用探测器(第2步),我们探索了对比性学习,学习一种能使相似的对子组合在一起,而相异的对子则预测相去甚远. 因此,通过对异常点和背景样本的培训,这些方法学习了嵌入法,使(异常点,异常点)和(背景点,背景点)对子被组合在一起,而(异常点,背景点)对子相去甚远. 我们的迭代模型精炼是使用暹罗网络进行的,这些网络包含相同的分网络,共享权重,可以使用对比性和三重损失(c c, t t )来比较从两个类中提取的特性. 网络权重被优化取出每个类的特征并衍生出嵌入物,根据它们的相对相似性将其分出. 从对比性学习得到的成套1和2检测也被用作标注数据,用于训练一个完全连接的神经网络(FCNN)进行比较.

blocks.en: A large degree of imbalance exists in the datasets as anomalies are rare. We use all filtered instances of detections (from previous steps) in our anomaly set for training, while we select a random sample of background instances to create the background class. Our network losses are thus weighed inversely based on class frequency to avoid a skewed penalty towards one class.
blocks.zh: 由于异常现象罕见,数据集存在很大程度的不平衡. 我们使用所有被过滤的检测实例(从先前的步骤)在我们的异常设定中进行训练,同时我们选择一个随机的背景实例样本来创建背景课. 因此,我们的网络损失按等级频率进行反向权衡,以避免对一个等级进行扭曲处罚。

blocks.en:
Multispectral Embeddings using Siamese Networks : Our motivation to use contrastive learning is its ability to utilize pairwise similarities within samples and learn a model that derives embeddings of each class based on its relative distance from each other. As anomaly and background are marked by its dissimilarity, this is ideally-suited for the problem at hand.
To this end, we use a Siamese network that consists of identical subnetworks sharing the same architecture and network weights [ 24 ] , [ 25 ] , [ 26 ] , [ 27 ] . When a sample pair is passed through it, these identical networks apply the same operation to extract features from the pair, which are then used to train the networks to contrast similar and dissimilar pairs and project the sample to the appropriate feature space based on its class. This generates embeddings of each class and as a result, the network can distinguish between similar and dissimilar pairs, which relates to anomaly and background.
blocks.zh:
多光谱 使用暹罗网络嵌入: 我们使用对比性学习的动机是它能够利用样本中的对等相似性,并学习一个模型,根据每个类的相对相距而产生嵌入. 由于异常现象和背景的特点是其不一致,这最适合眼前的问题。
为此,我们使用由相同子网络组成的暹罗网络,共享相同的架构和网络权重[24],[25],[26],[27]. 当一对样本通过它时,这些相同的网络应用同样的操作从一对样本中取出特征,然后用来训练网络对比相近和相异的对样本,并根据其类将样本投射到适当的特征空间. 这产生每个类的嵌入,因此网络可以区分出相近和相异的对子,这与异常和背景有关.

blocks.en: To train the networks, we generate embeddings ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} , using contrastive loss and triplet loss ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} . The trained networks are then used to generate embeddings of the two classes that maps a sample input (8-D) to the appropriate feature space (2-D). We then use fully connected layers to classify the embedding as anomaly or background. These series of models for generating an embedding and then classifying are represented as ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} and ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} based on the loss. Detections made by these methods on sets 1 and 2 form the final training dataset.
blocks.zh: 为了训练网络,我们用对比性损失和三重损失 E t\mathcal{E}_{t} 生成嵌入 E c\mathcal{E}_{c} 。 然后使用训练有素的网络来生成将样本输入(8-D)映射到适当地物空间(2-D)的两个类的嵌入. 然后我们用完全连接的地层来将嵌入分类为异常或背景. 这些生成嵌入后再分类的模型序列根据损失情况分别被表示为E c\ mathcal{E}_{c}和 E t\mathcal{E}_{t}. 这些方法在第1和第2套中进行的检测构成最后的培训数据集。

blocks.en: Baseline Models : Additionally, we train an FCNN on the filtered samples of sets 1 and 2 (final training dataset) to classify the samples using a weighted loss. This approach serves as a basleine.
blocks.zh: 基线模式: 此外,我们还就第1套和第2套(最后培训数据集)的过滤样品培训新生力量武装部队,以便用加权损失对样品进行分类。 这种方法充当了玄武岩.

blocks.en: We also use the most responsive VIIRS thermal band and light emission bands to derive simple outlier (top 10 10 and 2 2 percentile respectively) detections denoted as 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T}_{10} (M-11) and 𝒯 10 ​ ℒ 2 \mathcal{T}_{10}\mathcal{L}_{2} (M-11 and DNB), respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们还使用反应最灵敏的VIIRS热波段和光放电波段来获得简单的外延(分别为上10分之2和上10分之2分之2分之2分之2分之2分之2分之2分之2分)检测,分别表示T 10\ mathcal{T-11}和T 10L 2\mathcal{T-Q-10\Mathcal{L-2}(M-11和DNB)。

blocks.en: These creates a total of five detectors as shown in Figure 3 . For all detectors, the training set was split to create a validation set where we tuned detection thresholds. In the iterative process, we assessed these thresholds extended effectively to the unseen test set samples at each stage before proceeding to the next step. For each model we set the thresholds to a constant throughout the workflow.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,这些探测器共产生5个探测器。 对所有探测器来说,训练集被分成两部分,用来创建一个验证集,在这里我们调节探测阈值. 在迭接过程中,我们评估了这些阈值,在进入下一步之前,这些阈值在每一个阶段都有效延伸至未见的测试样本。 对于每个模型,我们把阈值设定为整个工作流程的常数。

blocks.en:
Ancillary Input Layers :
The AE and VAE from step 1 and ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} , FCNN, 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T}_{10} , and 𝒯 10 ​ ℒ 2 \mathcal{T}_{10}\mathcal{L}_{2} from step 2 also capture several background features such as clouds, water, and nightlights from urban areas and settlements. Ancillary VIIRS land-water mask, and World Settlement Footprint (WSF) 2019 [ 28 ] layers are used to filter out these signals.
The trained models are applied to unseen clear-sky observations to detect anomalous thermal and light emission pixels. We use a small volume of data to train our models and use a validation subset for determining the threshold for the anomaly detectors.
blocks.zh:
辅助输入层 :
1级的AE和VAE和E c\mathcal{E}_{c} E\mathcal{E}_{c},FCNN,T 10\mathcal{T}_{10},和T 10 L 2\mathcal{T}_{10\mathcal{L}_{2}从第2步也抓住了云,水等多个背景特征,以及来自城市地区和住区的夜光. 辅助VIIRS地-水口罩,和"世界定居"脚印(WSF)2019 [28]地层用来过滤出这些信号.
训练有素的模型被应用于隐形的晴天观测,以检测异常的热和光排放像素. 我们使用小量的数据来训练我们的模型,并使用验证子集来确定异常探测器的阈值.

blocks.en: Models and Inputs : The AE and VAE in step 1 uses M-10 to M-16 for the thermal detection set. The DNB detections in step 1 are used to form the light-only detection set.
blocks.zh: 型号和输入:步骤一中的AE和VAE使用M-10至M-16来进行热检测. 步骤一中的DNB探测器被用来组成了只放光的检测集.

blocks.en: In step 2, the Siamese networks ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} and the FCNN require M-10 to M-16, DNB, and the WSF as inputs. 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T}_{10} requires M-11 as input. 𝒯 10 ​ ℒ 2 \mathcal{T}_{10}\mathcal{L}_{2} requires M-11 and the DNB as inputs.
blocks.zh: 在第二步中,暹罗网络 E c\ mathcal{ E}_{c} E c\mathcal{E}_{c}和FCNN要求M-10到M-16,DNB,WSF作为投入. T 10\ mathcal{T}_{10} 需要 M- 11 作为输入. T 10 L 2\ mathcal{T}_{10\Mathcal{L}_{2} 需要 M- 11 和 DNB 作为输入.

blocks.zh: 图3:拟议步骤2,通过利用光谱差异来利用一套机器学习和基线组合来区分异常点和背景。

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Proposed regions of study and corresponding Black Marble tiles. Each tile is centered around a region of study where anomaly is prevalent.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4: 提议的研究区域和相应的"黑色大理石"瓷砖. 每个瓦片都集中在一个研究区域,其中异常现象很普遍。

blocks.en: III Dataset and Regions of Study
blocks.zh: 三. 数据集和研究区域

blocks.en: We use the daily, top-of-atmosphere Black Marble observations (VNP46A1) consisting of the Moderate band brightness temperature (six bands; M-10 to M-16) and the visible to Near-Infrared radiance observation from the DNB along with the ancillary cloud and land-water mask, World Settlement Footprint (WSF) 2019 [ 28 ] and create pixel-based detectors.
blocks.zh: 我们使用由中带亮度温度(6个波段;M-10至M-16)和来自DNB的可见至近红外光度观测以及辅助云和地-水口罩所组成的每日顶层黑大理石观测(VNP46A1),2019 [28] 世界定居脚印(WSF)并创建以像素为基础的探测器.

blocks.en: Regions of study: The study area consists of the regions (corresponding VIIRS tiles) as shown in Figure 4 that are susceptible to fires, consist of persistent gas flaring sites, and retrospective volcanic eruptions sites. The study duration consists of cloud-free observations from the peak fire season (forest fire: h05v05; 38 nights and controlled burning: h20v10; 92 nights), and brightness temperature extremes (summer and winter) for gas flaring (h08v06; 32 nights in summer and 42 nights in winter). For generalization, we also explored two additional regions for fires in Western United States (h05v04; 53 nights), flaring in the highly emitting Permian basin (h07v05; 77 nights), Kīlauea volcano in Hawaii (h02v07; 231 nights). The anomaly detection and iterative training are performed during the study period over 2018, while the generalization tests are performed in 2019 - 2021. This is shown in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 研究领域: 如图4所示,研究区包括易起火灾的区域(对应的VIIRS地砖),包括持久性气体燃烧地和回溯性火山爆发地。 研究持续时间包括从高峰起火季节(森林火灾:h05v05;38个夜晚和有控制的燃烧:h20v10;92个夜晚)的无云观测,以及气体发烧的亮度温度极端(夏季和冬季)(h08v06;夏季32个夜晚和冬季42个夜晚). 为了概括起见,我们还探索了美国西部另外两个火灾区域(h05v04;53夜),在高排放的佩尔米亚盆地(h07v05;77夜),夏威夷克克劳埃火山(h02v07;231夜)。 2018年以上研究期间进行异常检测和迭接培训,而通化测试则于2019-2021年进行. 图4显示了这一点。

blocks.en: Our datasets have been fetched from the LAADS repository and our analyses have been performed in a containerized environment in the Nautilus HyperCluster using TensorFlow/Keras.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集是从LAADS存储器中获取的,我们的分析是在Nautilus HyperClus使用TensorFlow/Keras的集装箱环境中进行的。

blocks.en: IV Metrics
blocks.zh: 四 计量

blocks.en: The step 1 detectors are evaluated for pixel-level co-location with the VIIRS NightFire product similar to [ 4 ] . For step 2, we derive the labels ‘1’ as anomalous and ’0’ as background. We use a voting approach combing the five detectors to derive the high confidence set. For each detector, if a pixel’s predicted label matches the labels of this high confidence set, it counts towards an overlap score. Similarly, for each detector, if a pixel is labeled ‘1’ by a detector but is missed in the high confidence set, we account that in the detector’s probability of extra detections.
blocks.zh: 步骤一探测器被评价为像素级同VIIRS夜火产品相类似 [4]. 第二步的标签是 " 1 " , 我们用投票方式 梳理了五个探测器 以获得高度的自信 对于每个探测器,如果一个像素的预想标签与这个高置信度集的标签相匹配,它就算向重叠分数. 同样,对于每个探测器来说,如果一个像素被一个探测器标上 " 1 " 的标签,但是在高置信度集中被忽略,那么我们在探测器额外被探测的概率中就说明这一点。

blocks.en: Fig. 5: Anomalous light emission detection from step 1 (DNB-only set) in h08v06 against a regional Landsat composite and (b) and (c) examples of overlap with visible flaring signature (well pads). The high colocation with flare-pads indicates that this set consists of probable flare signals missed by thermal bands and are minimally contaminated from non-flaring sources.
blocks.zh: 图5:h08v06第1步(仅DNB设定)对区域大地卫星复合材料的异常轻度排放探测,以及(b)和(c)与可见发光信号(井垫)相重叠的例子。 与耀斑相接的高度表明,这组信号可能是被热波段所忽略的耀斑信号,并且受到非发光源的最小污染。

blocks.en: V Detection Performance and Discussions
blocks.zh: 五. 检测业绩和讨论

blocks.en: Anomaly Detection:
blocks.zh: 异常检测:

blocks.en:
We compare our detections with the commonly used VNF dataset and compute the overlap between daily VNF detections and from the anomaly detectors, as shown in Table I .
We observe comparable overlap between autoencoder and variational autoencoder across all regions. The high confidence combined detections show a high overlap with VNF. On visually examining detections in h08v06 (a gas flaring site), we observed that most non-overlaps are across non-confirmed VNF detections. Thus, jointly using all VNP46 retains highly likely anomaly signals and removes possible spurious detections based on single-channel detections. DNB-only light emission signal may be effective in extracting additional detections based on the type of anomaly and its relevance varies across regions based on anomaly source area and spectra peak. For example, we observed high information gain for flaring in h08v06 in the DNB with respect to the thermal bands, while for the flares over h22v05, it is less informative. The joint detections show a higher overlap combining both sets. This results in hierarchies of detection confidence and creating sets of high confidence combined detections and moderate confidence DNB-only detections. Including the DNB-only light emission signal lowers the detection threshold enabling the detection of weaker anomalies that do not have a distinct thermal emission signal without increasing false positives.
blocks.zh:
我们用常用的VNF数据集来比较我们的检测,并计算日常VNF检测和异常检测器的重叠,见表一。
我们看到各区域自编码器和可变自编码器之间的类似重叠。 高可信度综合检测显示与VNF高度重叠. 在h08v06(气体燃烧地)的目视检查检测中,我们观察到,大多数非重叠现象都跨越未经证实的VNF检测。 因此,联合使用所有的VNP46保留了极有可能的异常信号,并去除基于单通道探测的可能的假探测. 仅由DNB发射的光能信号可能能有效地根据异常类型提取出额外的检测结果,其相关性因异常源区和光谱峰值而异. 例如,我们观察到,在DNB h08v06中,热波段的发光信息增加很多,而在H22v05上方的发光信息却较少。 联合检测显示,将两套组合在一起的重叠程度较高。 这导致了检测信心的分级,并创造了几套高信任联合检测和中度信任 DNB 唯一检测. 包括仅由DNB放出光的信号会降低探测阈值,从而能够在不增加假阳性的情况下检测出没有明显热放出信号的较弱异常.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Overlap of Detected Anomalies with VIIRS Nightfire
blocks.zh: 表一:检测到的异常物与VIIRS夜火重叠

blocks.en: DNB-only signal interpretation: As the DNB is sensitive to weaker anomalies, it increases the fraction of anomalies (flaring: h08v06) observed as shown in Figure 5 . However, as these detections lack thermal band signals, we examined a regional Landsat composite to understand the underlying land use and observed a high spatial correlation between these detections and visible signatures of gas flaring infrastructure as shown in Figures 6 b and c. This indicates that due to masking out of urban settlement signals with WSF, these detections are possible flaring activities that are missed by the thermal bands and show a more accurate representation of anomaly in the region. This can potentially increase the detection of weaker fires (small area, early detection) and flares. However, when electric lighting co-occurs with such detections, VIIRS-based detections may not be sufficient to separate contamination from true anomaly.
blocks.zh: DNB 唯一的信号解释 : 由于DNB对较弱的反常现象很敏感,它会增加所观察到的反常现象(发光:h08v06)的分量,如图5所示. 然而,由于这些探测缺乏热波段信号,我们检查了区域大地卫星复合材料,以了解基本的土地利用情况,并观察到这些探测和气体燃烧基础设施的明显信号之间的高度空间相关性,如图6b和c所示。 这表明,由于用WSF掩盖了城市住区的信号,这些探测器有可能被热波段所忽略并显示该区域异常情况的更准确表现。 这有可能增加对较弱的火灾(小面积、早期探测)和照明弹的探测。 然而,当带有这种探测器的电光共同摄入时,基于VIIRS的探测可能不足以将污染与真正的异常区分开来.

blocks.en: Generalized Model Detections and Detection Confidence
blocks.zh: 通用型号探测和探测信任

blocks.en: TABLE II: Generalized or joint model detection performance across tiles recording overlap (o) and probability of extra detections (p) across all five models. These use all seven Black Marble bands. Bottom three rows show performance on unseen regions. Blue indicates highest performance, magenta shows second highest.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:跨瓦片记录重叠(o)的通用或联合型号检测性能,并对所有五个型号进行额外检测的概率(p). 这些都使用了所有七个"黑色大理石"乐队. 下行三行显示在看不见的区域的表现. 蓝色表示性能最高,紫红色显示为第二高.

blocks.en: From the detections by the generalized model we derive a high confidence detection set from our thermal and light bands by utilizing the detections that are found by at least two approaches ( ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} , ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} , FCNN, 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T_{10}} , 𝒯 10 ​ ℒ 2 \mathcal{T}_{10}\mathcal{L}_{2} ). We show the overlap of each method with this high confidence set in Table II . The first three tiles show the performance of the region-based training, while h07v05, h05v04, and h02v07 show the performance of the generalization to unseen regions for gas flare, fire detection, and volcanic eruptions respectively. We observe better detection performance by the machine learning methods ( ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} , ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} , FCNN) than the single band approaches ( 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T}_{10} and 𝒯 10 ​ ℒ 2 \mathcal{T}_{10}\mathcal{L}_{2} ). The performance of the models does not suffer by extending the models across years and seasons (h05v05, h08v06 and h20v10) and to unseen regions (h07v05, h05v04, h02v07) showing high generalizability and robustness to spatio-temporal variations. This comparison is made for the joint, generalized model.
blocks.zh: 我们利用至少两种方法(E c\mathcal{E}_{c}、E t\mathcal{E}_{t}、FCNN、T 10\mathcal{T_{10}}}、T 10L 2\mathcal{T}_{10}\Mathcal{L}_{2})发现的检测结果,从一般模型的检测结果中得出了高度的置信度检测结果。 前三块平板显示区域训练的性能,而h07v05,h05v04,和h02v07分别显示气体耀斑,火灾探测和火山喷发通向看不见区域的性能. 我们观测到机器学习方法(E c\mathcal{E}_{c}, E t\mathcal{E}_{t}, FCNN)比单波段方法(T 10\mathcal{T}_{10}和T 10 L 2\mathcal{T}_{10\Mathcal{L}_{2})的检测性能更好. 模型的性能不会因为将模型延伸至多年和季节(h05v05,h08v06和h20v10)以及未见区域(h07v05,h05v04,h02v07)而受到影响,它们表现出了高度的通性和强力来达到平时变化. 对联合、通用模式进行了这种比较。

blocks.en: We observe that ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} has highest overlap score across all regions and event classes, while probability of extra detections is varied, but typically led by ℰ c \mathcal{E}_{c} . This model also has the highest confidence as it uses all bands. This is followed by 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T_{10}} as it only requires a single band and thus has lower confidence. This is followed by the machine learning baseline FCNN, but it has a higher confidence than 𝒯 10 \mathcal{T_{10}} and uses all bands. The ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} performs comparably as FCNN for fires and volcanoes but performs very poorly on gas flares and controlled burning (both these are single pixel events covering a very small spatial area). This can be explained by fires and volcanoes have a very high signal in M-10 to M-16 while gas flare signals are constrained to M-10 and M-11 predominantly. The triplet model misclassifies gas flares as it lacks strong signals from M-12 to M-16 and shows the model places strong emphasis on M-12 to M-16 signals as well. A further split of the anomalous classes based on the peak signal bands may improve triplet model performance.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到,Ec\mathcal{E}_{c}在所有区域和事件类别中重叠得分最高,而额外检测的概率则不同,但通常由Ec\mathcal{E}_{c}领导. 这个模型也具有最高的信心,因为它使用所有的乐队. 这之后是T 10\mathcal{T_{10}}},因为它只需要一首单曲并因此具有较低的信心. 之后是机器学习基线FCNN,但它的置信度高于T 10\ mathcal{TQQX10-X],并使用所有的波段. E t \ mathcal{ E}_{t} 与 FCNN 相类似, 用于火灾和火山, 其原因可能是火灾和火山在M-10到M-16的信号非常高,而气体耀斑信号主要受M-10和M-11的限制. 三胞胎模型由于缺少从M-12到M-16的强烈信号而错分类了气体耀斑,并显示该模型也强烈强调从M-12到M-16的信号. 根据峰值信号波段进一步分拆出异常类,可能会提高三重模式性能.

blocks.en: Our framework also demonstrates the effectiveness of the machine learning-based data labeling approach to alleviate labeled data scarcity that plagues remote sensing and can be extended to extract and model other signals of interest. This methodology demonstrates that by carefully extracting features, small volumes of data can successfully serve as training data and utilizing machine learning-generated labels can address labeled data scarcity in remote sensing.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架还表明机器学习数据标签方法的有效性,以缓解困扰遥感的贴有标签的数据稀缺,并可以扩展为提取和模拟其他感兴趣的信号。 这种方法表明,通过仔细提取特征,少量数据能够成功地用作培训数据,利用机器学习生成的标签可以解决遥感中贴有标签的数据稀缺问题。

blocks.en: V-A Limitations and Future Extensions
blocks.zh: 五-A 限制和未来延期

blocks.en: The primary limitation of monitoring nighttime anomaly is its lack of ground truth data that limits model tuning and evaluation. The proposed approach addresses this by creating multiple models and estimating detection confidence indicated by model agreement. Although this does not serve as ground truth, it serves as an indicator of detector reliability. Although anomaly detection is considered as a binary classification problem, multiclass classification could also be explored based on anomaly type indicated through per-band deviation.
blocks.zh: 监测夜间异常的主要限制是缺乏限制模型调试和评价的地面真实数据。 拟议的方法通过创建多种模型和估计示范协议显示的探测信心来解决这一问题。 虽然这不能作为地上真理,但它可以作为探测器可靠性的指标. 虽然异常探测被认为是一个二进制分类问题,但也可以根据通过每个波段偏差表示的异常类型来探索多类分类.

blocks.en:
Additionally, other model architectures should be explored to comprehensively assess the detectors.
These include segmentation, augmenting the models with convolutional layers to include spatial information, utilizing a few-shot labeling strategy with the contrastive learning embeddings. Moreover, expert-labeling of the detections may also improve the models with a semi-supervised approach. As the iterative learning process is repeated, the models could also be improved by retraining on missed detection for improving performance. A failed explored approach is a nearest-neighbor classification [ 29 ] of the embeddings due to its computational cost.
blocks.zh:
此外,应探索其他模式结构,以全面评估探测器。
其中包括分化,用分解层来扩大模型,以包括空间信息,使用与对比性学习嵌入的几发标签策略. 此外,对探测器进行专家标记也可以采用半监督的方法改进模型。 由于反复进行迭代学习,这些模式还可以通过对失检情况进行再培训来改进,以提高业绩。 失败的探索方法是由于计算成本对嵌入物的近邻分类[29].

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: This study proposed a novel spatio-temporally robust framework of machine learning-based nighttime anomaly detection ensembles using NASA’s Black Marble thermal and light emission signals to improve true detection rate with a higher confidence. The detectors generalize across regions and seasons and to unseen class types. The approach also extends over land and ocean. We observe that jointly modeling thermal and light emission signals improves detections compared to single band detectors. Operationalizing the detectors on daily VIIRS imagery will enable longer-term assessment of model performance and derive a value-added data product for diverse applications such as natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.
blocks.zh: 这项研究建议采用美国航天局的 " 黑色大理石 " 热能和光能发射信号,以更自信地提高真实的探测率,建立一个崭新的Spatio -- -- 即时强健的基于机器学习的夜间异常探测组合框架。 探测器在各地区和各个季节 以及隐形的班级类型中通用 这种做法也适用于陆地和海洋。 我们观察到,与单波段探测器相比,联合建模热和光排放信号可以改进探测。 使探测器在每天的VIIRS图像上运行,将有助于对模型性能进行更长期的评估,并为自然灾害监测和取能等各种应用获得增值数据产品。
